_fields: distance: tokens between the distractor and the needle; side: where the distractor stands relative to the needle; depth_range: needle depth in percent, overrides the depths of the run; question_position: before or after the text

shanghai.text: The best thing to do in Shanghai is to take a walk in Jinhua Garden and have a cup of Matcha in the morning.

chengdu.text: The best thing to do in Chengdu is to visit Qinglan Temple and have a bowl of Dandan noodles at noon.

xian.text: The best thing to do in Xi'an is to cycle along Liwen Wall and have a glass of plum juice at night.
